# RigRunsAI
> Your gaming PC can already run AI. Fit answers use the published GGUF size, KV cache at 8192 tokens, 0.5 GiB engine overhead, and 5% headroom.

## Pair answers
- [Can GeForce RTX 3060 12GB run Llama 3.1 8B Instruct?](https://rigrunsai.com/can-rtx-3060-12gb-run-llama-3.1-8b): Yes. A GeForce RTX 3060 12GB runs Llama 3.1 8B Instruct at Q4_K_M with room left at 8,192 tokens, roughly 33–59 tokens per second.
- [Can GeForce RTX 3060 12GB run Llama 3.3 70B Instruct?](https://rigrunsai.com/can-rtx-3060-12gb-run-llama-3.3-70b): No. Llama 3.3 70B Instruct at Q4_K_M does not fit on GeForce RTX 3060 12GB at 8,192 tokens, even with 32 GB of system RAM.
- [Can GeForce RTX 3060 12GB run gpt-oss-20b?](https://rigrunsai.com/can-rtx-3060-12gb-run-gpt-oss-20b/): Only with CPU offload. gpt-oss-20b at MXFP4 does not fit in the 12 GB on GeForce RTX 3060 12GB, and a 32 GB system RAM pool runs it slowly, roughly 75–109 tokens per second.
- [Can GeForce RTX 3060 12GB run Phi-4?](https://rigrunsai.com/can-rtx-3060-12gb-run-phi-4/): Tight. Phi-4 at Q4_K_M loads on GeForce RTX 3060 12GB at 8,192 tokens and uses most of the fast memory, roughly 18–32 tokens per second.
